title: A client cannot send its restore block in its hello
body:
`Hello` has a public `restore: Option<Restore>` field, and decade reads a restore block from a hello (see "Messages to decade" in `docs/protocol.md`). But `Channel::connect` builds the `Hello` itself and always sets `restore: None` (`decade-channel/src/lib.rs`, in `connect`). A client can only set its restore block with a separate `Channel::restore` call after connecting, so the field is unusable from the client side.

## Proposal

`connect` and `from_env` take the restore block, or connecting takes a `Hello` the caller fills in. The choice belongs with "What should connecting look like in decade-channel?".
